parameters.drv_seq_note: CPI instruction sequence is an unused estimate; measured values from results/driver_overhead.json are used

inputs.p_star_definition: SPEC C5: smallest P with sum(STAMP) <= 1.10 * sum(STAMP)(P=16), accelerator only; p_star_end_to_end uses predicted_model_run
inputs.layers: DESIGN 2 table, checked against model.c by test

biases: PSETUP: the +1 cycle per pixel is hidden behind the requantizer where a layer is requant or credit bound; the model keeps the +1 (conservative). Over-prediction by command: mnist op_1 +3.4 % (P=8,16), cifar op_2 +3.0 % (P=8,16), cifar op_4 +3.0 % (P=16), cifar op_0 +1.9 % (P=16), cifar op_6 +1.3 % (P=16), all others < 0.5 %

FLUSH: the real remainder after the last issue is NV + 10 cycles; the model's W_last + 2*lam + 10 + NV counts the last tile's W_t and NV in both T_tile and FLUSH and over-predicts by 2 + W_last cycles per command (<= P + 3; <= 7 at P=16)
*_WAIT phases: +0 cycles if fetch idle is combinational as specified (DESIGN 8.4); a registered idle would add <= 4 cycles per command (0.6 % worst case, cifar op_15 at P=16)

Driver: drv_chain = 71 was measured on the stub (first poll sees DONE); a real chain adds ~6-7 cycles of phase wait, +3 for call-site addressing, and the per-model_run-call bind check (~8-10 cycles) is not modelled: ~40 cycles under-prediction on mnist (0.2 %)
STAMP is self-reported by the ctrl counter; M5/M6 assert per chain that CYCLES == sum(STAMP + lam + 1) + 2 and count at least three commands independently from a VCD

(T1.2) C4(b) measurement side: the profile macros (MCUACCEL_PROF_END 64-bit accumulate, ~30-40 cycles per op), the call/return around each accelerated chain function and the model_run prologue land in the measured interval but not in c4b_pred_cycles: ~200-500 cycles under-prediction (~1-2 % on mnist, < 0.5 % on cifar)
(T1.2) y_align = 0 is assumed (bench_main's s_out has no alignment attribute and is not extracted from the link map); a misaligned output costs <= 1 cycle per tile of the final fc

(T1.2) software-op cycles: the profile build is 0.46 % faster than the uninstrumented cifar baseline on the same 2 images, so the compiled fallback code is not identical across builds; these cycles are measurements, not scored
bus_rd counts NT * sum_pix R (x re-fetched per tile)
